new.text: 7.9.5 Cores under control of the AUTOSAR OS The AUTOSAR OS controls several cores as stated above. It need not control all cores of a µC, however. The maximum number of controlled cores shall be configured within the OsOS section of the configuration. The AUTOSAR OS API provides a StartCore function to start the cores under its control. The StartCore function takes a scalar value parameter of type CoreIdType, specifying the core that shall be started. StartCore can be called more than once on the master core and also on slave cores.
